description: Agent Automotive: submit a vehicle inspection report with the inspection checklist or standard as provided: the report with the station, inspector, VIN, day inspected, each item with its id, name, result as printed (pass, fail, advisory or not inspected) and measurement where it prints one, and the overall result (pass or fail); the checklist with its standard and each item with its id, name, whether it is required, whether a fail on it fails the inspection, and its minimum and maximum where it states them. The signed report gives the report and the checklist, each printed item matched to its checklist item, the required items with no result, the items the checklist does not list or names otherwise, each measurement against the checklist’s limits, and the overall result against the item results, and counts them, and names a misreported report: a required item with no result or printed not inspected, a passing result with a measurement outside the checklist’s limit, and an overall result unlike the item results under the checklist’s rules; then a fail with a measurement inside the limit, an item the checklist does not list and an item printed under another name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An item the checklist limits that prints no measurement leaves the report unverified. Items meet by id, then by name. This check reports whether the report matches its own checklist; it never judges whether a vehicle is safe. Beside it, wever_realty-inspection-check reads a property inspection report against the summary made from it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, and wever_deliverable-check reads delivered work against a job’s acceptance criteria, while the inspection check reads a vehicle inspection’s items and results against the checklist it was run on. Verdict auto_inspection_misreported, auto_inspection_partial, auto_inspection_unverified or auto_inspection_faithful. POST /api/auto-inspection-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.

items.description: Each checklist item as the checklist or standard states it.

fails_inspection.description: Whether a fail on the item fails the inspection; true when left out.

required.description: Whether the checklist requires the item; true when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

items.description: Each item and its result as printed.

measurement.description: The measurement as printed, where the item states one.
